description: This file defines the `VisibilityObserver` class that manages listening to visibility change and focus events in the browser to detect changes in window focus or tab visibility, debouncing the event notifications.

classes.name: VisibilityObserver
classes.description: A class that observes browser visibility and focus events, debounces notifications, and triggers a callback upon such events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the observer with a callback and sets up event listeners for visibility change and window focus.

methods.name: onVisibilityChange
methods.description: Handler invoked when the document's visibility state changes; notifies whether the window became visible or hidden.

methods.name: onFocusEvent
methods.description: Handler invoked on window focus event; signals window focus.

methods.name: notifyEvent
methods.description: Debounces and invokes the callback with the appropriate WebAppEvent.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes event listeners and clears references for cleanup.
